# Bundled English pronunciation

9,704 unique entries covering everyday, ky, ielts and toefl decks.
These are synthesized US-English readings, not human dictionary recordings.
Generated with Windows Microsoft Zira Desktop at rate -1, PCM 22,050 Hz mono;
encoded as 48 kbps MP3 sprites. index.json stores [file, startSeconds, durationSeconds].
Each word is synthesized separately; a 0.2-second silent gap separates entries.
Browser playback decodes a sprite with Web Audio and plays only the selected range.
The website does not invoke phone speech synthesis or external pronunciation APIs.
Polyphonic words are read in isolation and may need contextual pronunciation review.
